name: Energia C3045N (tubeless)

origin.basis: CST is the Cheng Shin (正新) brand of Taiwan's Cheng Shin Rubber; China listings give the brand as CST/正新.

manufacturing.basis: The listing does not state the factory; Cheng Shin also makes bicycle tires at a mainland plant.

positioning: Tubeless version of the CST Energia C3045, sold in 28 mm.

availability.note: Sold by a Tmall shop; no official CST store listing was read for this version.

price_observations.market: 东之耀运动户外专营店 (Tmall)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts on 2026-11-01 for one C3045N 700X28C tubeless tire; coupon price CNY 121.85.

caveats: Weight is the shop's approximate figure; TPI and pressure limits are not published.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components catalogues and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this model; questions, seller and maker replies, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out. C3045 clincher reports are not transferred to this tubeless model.
